The Temporal Nexus

A multi-dimensional view of change ringing. Nodes cluster mathematically based on shared history.

The base layer forms a geographical map of the UK. Methods, ringers, and performances naturally gravitate toward the locations where they are most active.

Click any node to fly to it and view its narrative.
